entry.name: array.slice
entry.digest: Output a range of elements of an array object as a new array object
entry.description: array.slice is similar to array.subarray, but attempts to conform to the JavaScript Array.slice() behavior.

arguments.name: slice-indeces
arguments.description: Set the range to slice when an array is received in the leftmost inlet. Negative values index from the end of the array, and a single value on its own implicitly stretches to the end of the array. If the end of the range is before the start, then the elements of the range will be reversed.
